title: Synchronized cross-mesh log correlation
description: Include ts (unix_timestamp) field in all LCI diagnostic event payloads: /status/node, /status/queues, /status/neighbors, /status/routes, and any future diagnostic resources. Because all nodes share GNSS time, events from different nodes and meshes are directly comparable without NTP correction. Enables cross-mesh timeline reconstruction, custody chain debugging, and congestion analysis. Spec: 11-lci.md §17.2. All three impls.
